boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Temple University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops on or near Temple’s Main Campus with late availability documented on current official location or business pages.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on North 12th
cards.subtitle: 1717 N 12th St, near Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the walk-up window or dine-in service when you need a late meal; confirm the day’s service mode before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A documented midnight option steps from Main Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists this 1717 N 12th St restaurant as open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; its walk-up window is listed until midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours to 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; walk-up window hours are to 12:00 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Subway on Cecil B. Moore Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1511 Cecil B. Moore Ave, by Temple’s Main Campus
cards.notes: Plan a pickup around the posted nightly close and use the restaurant’s ordering link or phone if you need to confirm service.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich stop whose own site posts an 11:30 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: The Subway Temple University site lists its location at 1511 Cecil B. Moore Avenue and hours of 9:00 a.m.–11:30 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily hours of 9:00 a.m.–11:30 p.m.; verify availability before leaving.

cards.title: Chipotle at 1100 W. Montgomery
cards.subtitle: 1100 W. Montgomery Ave, on Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the restaurant page before going, then use in-store pickup or ordering during its listed late-evening service window.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge Chipotle with an official 11 p.m. close listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s Philadelphia locations page identifies the Temple University restaurant at 1100 W. Montgomery Ave and lists it as closing at 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill locations in Philadelphia
cards.access_notes: Official location directory lists the Temple University restaurant at 1100 W. Montgomery Ave as closing at 11:00 p.m.; check the individual location for exceptions.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies on Cecil B. Moore
cards.subtitle: 1394 Cecil B. Moore Ave, near Broad Street
cards.notes: Use the store locator to confirm the current Templetown hours and choose pickup or delivery only within the posted service window.
cards.short_summary: A cookie shop beside campus with late-night hours documented by its official locator.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ official store locator states that its stores deliver warm cookies until 3 a.m. daily; the company identifies Templetown among its Pennsylvania locations.
cards.access_notes: Official locator advertises delivery until 3:00 a.m. daily; select the Templetown store to confirm its live pickup and delivery hours.

cards.title: Maxi's on Liacouras Walk
cards.subtitle: 1926 Liacouras Walk, on Temple’s campus
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted contact details to confirm the day’s kitchen service before walking over for pizza or a sandwich.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus pizza and sandwich counter with a posted 11 p.m. weekday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Maxi’s official site places the restaurant at 1926 Liacouras Walk and lists Monday–Friday hours of 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Friday hours ending at 11:00 p.m. and lists the site as closed Saturday–Sunday; confirm current food service before visiting.

cards.title: McDonald's at 2nd and Lehigh
cards.subtitle: Philadelphia, about a mile east of Main Campus
cards.notes: If you are traveling off campus, use the posted drive-thru hours and confirm the route and service option before departing.
cards.short_summary: A nearby 24-hour drive-thru option with separately posted lobby hours.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists its 2nd Lehigh Ave Philadelphia restaurant’s drive-thru as open 24 hours daily, while lobby hours end at 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 24-hour drive-thru service every day and lobby service until 10:00 p.m.; do not assume indoor seating is available late.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on North Broad
cards.subtitle: 150 N Broad St, Center City Philadelphia
cards.notes: Use this only when already heading through Center City; the official location page lists round-the-clock access and hot-food features.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience stop farther south on Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven’s official page for 150 N Broad St, Philadelphia lists the store as open 24/7 and includes hot foods among its store features.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store as open 24/7; it is in Center City rather than immediately beside Temple’s Main Campus.

cards.title: Johnson & Hardwick Dining Center
cards.subtitle: 2029 N. Broad St, Main Campus
cards.notes: Check Dining Services for the active schedule and use your eligible payment method; late availability can change for holidays and weather.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall dining destination with documented late campus service during a recent disruption.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple’s January 2026 storm announcement states that Johnson & Hardwick’s Louis J. Esposito Dining Center was scheduled to remain open until 10:00 p.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Temple University: Preparing for this weekend’s storm
cards.access_notes: Temple documented a 10:00 p.m. Sunday close for the January 2026 storm schedule; this is schedule-specific, so consult current Dining Services hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Night Owl Events at the Student Center
cards.title: Night Owl at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Temple Student Center, Main Campus
cards.notes: Look for the current Friday event listing before going; the university describes an alcohol-free evening of performances, prizes, music, and food.
cards.short_summary: A campus-hosted Friday-night destination that runs to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple’s New Student and Family Programs glossary says Night Owl Events are free, include food, and take place in the Student Center from 8 p.m. to midnight every Friday.
cards.access_notes: Temple’s official glossary describes Night Owl Events as Friday programs from 8:00 p.m. to midnight; confirm that week’s program and entry details.

cards.entity_name: Midnight Breakfast at J&H Dining Hall
cards.title: Midnight Breakfast at J&H
cards.subtitle: J&H Dining Hall, Temple Main Campus
cards.notes: Treat this as a dated, campus-program opportunity: watch Temple Honors announcements for future finals-period events and eligibility details.
cards.short_summary: A documented student event at J&H that ran through midnight without a meal swipe.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Honors announced its December 2025 Midnight Breakfast at J&H Dining Hall for 9:30 p.m.–12:00 a.m., free to Temple students with no meal swipe or money required.
cards.access_notes: The official post documents a December 8, 2025 event ending at midnight; it does not establish recurring hours. Check for a current event before attending.

warnings: Two campus-program cards document specific late-night events rather than standing nightly operations; their access notes explicitly require checking for a current event.
